originals: Skipped cell visit?
If the cell visit is skipped, is there a body in the evidence
The self-destruction of Carlos' android is narrated in the outcome of the second
entries.answer: If Connor does not visit him before sitting down at the desk, his body does not appear in the evidence room and Connor still remembers what he said; whether he survives is not stated.
entries.source: Wiki Waiting for Hank... Notes: 'It is possible to skip the interaction with Carlos Ortiz's HK400 if Connor does not go see him before sitting down at the desk. Doing so allows you to remember what the android said without him appearing in the evidence room'
